PLAN "General Strength, Cardio, Nutrition & Recovery for Post-L4-L5 Herniation (12 Weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build general strength safely post-disc herniation"
  GOAL secondary nutrition:
    name "Support recovery and reduce inflammation with nutrition"
  GOAL secondary cardio:
    name "Improve cardiovascular health safely"
  GOAL secondary recovery:
    name "Enhance sleep and recovery for optimal progress"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1-4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday cardio 30m "Cardio 1":
        modality:
          cycling 30m rpe 6
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Body & Core A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday cardio 30m "Cardio 2":
        modality:
          elliptical 30m rpe 6
      DAY Friday training 45m "Upper Body B":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
          back_stretch 2m
      DAY Sunday nutrition "Anti-Inflammatory Focus":
        guidelines:
          - Emphasize fatty fish (salmon, sardines, mackerel) 2-3x/week for omega-3s
          - Include a variety of colorful vegetables and fruits daily (especially berries, leafy greens, cruciferous vegetables)
          - Use extra virgin olive oil as primary fat source
          - Add nuts and seeds (walnuts, chia, flaxseed) regularly
          - Choose whole grains (quinoa, brown rice, oats) over refined grains
          - Include legumes (beans, lentils) several times per week
          - Limit processed foods, added sugars, and fried foods
          - Use herbs and spices with anti-inflammatory properties (turmeric, ginger, garlic)
          - Stay hydrated with water and green tea
          - Limit red and processed meats
      DAY Sunday recovery "Sleep & Recovery Protocol":
        guidelines:
          - Aim for 7.5–9 hours of sleep per night, maintaining a consistent bedtime and wake time
          - Create a dark, cool, quiet sleep environment
          - Avoid screens and bright lights for 30–60 minutes before bed
          - Limit caffeine after 2pm and avoid heavy meals within 2 hours of bedtime
          - Practice a relaxing pre-sleep routine (reading, gentle stretching, deep breathing)
          - Use a supportive mattress and pillow to maintain neutral spine alignment
          - Schedule at least one full rest day per week
          - Use active recovery (walking, stretching, cycling) on non-training days if desired
          - Monitor fatigue and adjust training intensity if sleep quality declines
